## Amendment A1 (post-freeze correction, 2026-11-07)

**Dated 2026-11-07, written before the re-scoring ran. Reason:** an independent check of step 0 found that stage 0c took sigma_r from residuals scored by the shipped engine, whose pH balance (B0) M1b part (i) falsified, while stage 0a's worlds use the carried balance rivals B1 / B13. The two pH-lever studies whose residuals set the sulfur sigma_r (xu2007, pH 5.6 / 7 / 8; Hofmann 1998, pH 3 / 7) were scored under B0. Their misses are therefore partly B0's pH failure, which the step-0 worlds have already removed. Counting them in sigma_r counts B0's failure twice. The frozen v3.1 text is not edited; this amendment is recorded here and in its revision log.

**What A1 changes:**
- **(a0) The check's concern, and what the prereg's lanes say.** The check asked that non-thiol species (Meynier NF; xu2007 furfural, 2-acetylthiazole) not set the thiol sigma_r. The prereg's lanes are ENGINE lanes ("thiol = sulfur lane", sec. 5.0.1), and the engine integrates every source-3 row on the sulfur lane, so (a) below moves no row. The concern is therefore met by a sensitivity, reported and not binding: "rival-scored, thiol species only". It takes the sulfur-lane groups of thiols and their disulfides only (MFT, FFT, their dimers, methanethiol). Changing the binding lane definition after the freeze would be a change of the frozen rule, which this amendment does not make.
- **(a) A generator fix.** Source 3's rows are given their engine lane (from `declare_envelope` on each pot and species, no run) and their own exposure, where the generator as first run hard-coded "sulfur" and out of sample. The prereg's lanes are engine lanes (sec. 5.0.1).
- **(b) Reporting fixes.** E is reported at sigma_r in {0.593, 0.42, 0.19}, which sec. 7.1 lists. A derived rho below -1 is printed as "impossible: omega and sigma_r disagree (the engine over-responds to levers)".
- **(c) The rival-scored reading.** Every out-of-sample sulfur-lane pair is re-scored under each of PR #108's 23 rival points at 5e61fed0, with the shipped constants otherwise. Per group, the within-group sum of squares is averaged over the points, since each stage-0a world is one point. sigma_r then follows from sec. 5.0.1's estimator unchanged (G_min, floor, t-interval, LOSO).
- **(d) Two rival-scored variants:**
  - **"rival-scored, all sulfur units":** every out-of-sample sulfur pair re-scored;
  - **"rival-scored, xu2007 + Hofmann only":** the check's variant, with the other studies kept B0-scored.
- **(e) Which reading binds, chosen before any number:** "rival-scored, all sulfur units". A stage-0a world is a B1 or B13 engine, so every residual that sets its discrepancy must come from that engine. Re-scoring only the two flagged studies would leave the other studies' B0 residuals in. The other two readings are reported beside it.
  - Stage 0a's eligibility is recomputed under each reading from the same 512 cached worlds, with no new world.
  - Its point value and both LOSO ends bind (sec. 5.0.1): if they disagree, layer 1 is UNDECIDED.
- **(f) A diagnostic** (A1 item 3): the slope of observed on predicted log ratios, and the leave-one-study-out calibrated contrast against no change. It is reported, and decides nothing.

Re-scoring: 55 out-of-sample sulfur-lane pairs (44 arms) under B0 and PR #108's 23 rival points (sha256 d92af52c4f48); 0.51 core-h, 0.26 h wall at 2 processes. B0 parity with the on-disk engine values: max 0.0000 dex over 55 pairs.

### Lever skill out of sample (A1 item 3; sulfur lane, out-of-sample pairs)

| scoring | pairs | studies | slope beta of observed on predicted | 90 % CI (CR1, t on G - 1) | LOSO calibrated median abs error | no-change median abs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B0-scored | 55 | 6 | 0.15 | -0.13 - 0.43 | 0.39 | 0.34 |
| B0-scored, without xu2007 and Hofmann | 48 | 4 | 0.36 | -0.19 - 0.92 | 0.36 | 0.33 |
| rival-scored (mean over the 23 points) | 55 | 6 | 0.21 | -0.06 - 0.48 | 0.39 | 0.34 |

The check reported beta = 0.18 (90 % CI -0.06 to 0.42), 0.37 without the B0-pH studies, and a LOSO calibrated contrast of 0.63 vs 0.57 dex no-change (0.50 vs 0.49 without them). The numbers above are this generator's own, by the method stated in the table. Read together: out of sample, the engine shows no lever skill even after shrinkage. A diagnostic; it decides nothing.

**What the re-scoring found.** Under B1 / B13 the two flagged studies still miss as much as under B0 (per-study sigma_r xu2007 2.78 -> 2.62, Hofmann 2.51 -> 2.58 dex). Their misses are not B0's pH-balance failure: xu2007 is a declared-pyrophosphate design, where the balance rivals move little. So the check's premise does not hold, and dropping the two studies (which would give ~0.5 dex) has no basis in the rule. The binding sulfur sigma_r is the rival-scored 1.23 dex.
